candidates.title: Story Path Selection Split Showcase
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into a split layout showcasing companion path choices and preview outcomes.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a 76.2% conversion rate and high mean time (514s), indicating hesitation during initial path selection.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Companion Path
choose_path.body: Select how you would like to create your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Redesigns the path selection screen within onboarding without removing required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Addresses choose_path drop-off and hesitation, but layout redesign requires UI work and lacks support email validation.

candidates.title: Account Cloud Sync Safety Guarantee
candidates.change: Add clear copy guaranteeing cloud saving so users know their pets will never reset upon signing in again.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet data is safely backed up to the cloud and restored anytime.
sign_in.body: Create or sign in to your account to securely store your pet's progress and custom appearance.

guard.reason: Adds helpful account safety copy to the sign-in screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and funnel; simple copy change reassuring data safety with low implementation effort.

candidates.title: Companion Name and Trait Crafting Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated companion trait crafting screen into the adoption flow before final certificate generation.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 69.7% conversion rate and high time taken (median 89s / mean 1017s), benefiting from clearer milestone steps.

pick_friend.hint: Select your favorite pet companion before customizing their personality and name.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_trait_crafting']

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Progress Interactive Flow
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen with an animated progress visualization and interactive tips during rendering.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing drop-off or uncertainty while waiting for generation.

guard.reason: Rebuilds the waiting screen with progress indicators while preserving its required job of showing the pet being created.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at long home step wait times via funnel data, but building an interactive flow requires significant engineering cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Placement and Control Hub Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home introduction screen into a stage layout detailing desktop pet controls and visibility shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support receives recurrent tickets regarding confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Learn how to summon, interact with, or hide your desktop pet using quick controls.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro screen inside onboarding to show pet controls.

candidates.score_note: Backed by support tickets and funnel data; finish redesigns show modest positive history (+2.0% average), but cost is high.

candidates.title: Sign In Staging Notification Banner
candidates.change: Add a prominent connection hint banner on sign-in reassuring users if auth takes a few seconds.
candidates.why: Support tickets noted sign-in screen delays or stalling before authentication loads.

sign_in.hint: Connecting to secure authentication service... Please wait a moment.

guard.reason: Adds a reassuring connection hint to the sign-in screen during onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets sign-in latency complaints with a low-cost hint, though notification/hint historical lift remains modest (+1.0%).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Visual Framing Layout
candidates.change: Change the adoption certificate screen layout to centered with an official stamp style component.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is over 30% and users take a long time to complete it.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.official_stamp' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'badge', 'image'] with an asset:stamp/ asset

candidates.title: Pet Generation Estimated Time Display
candidates.change: Enable visual time estimation and readiness notification alerts on the pet preparation waiting screen.
candidates.why: Mean wait time on the waiting screen reaches 2336 seconds, causing users to abandon the app thinking it froze.

waiting.hint: Your pet is being generated. You can minimize this window and we will notify you when ready.

guard.reason: Adds a time estimate and readiness notification to the waiting screen for a real wait duration.

candidates.score_note: Addresses severe duration skew on home wait step; reasonable cost to add visual timing expectations.

candidates.title: First Companion Welcome Gift Badge
candidates.change: Add an instant starter gift badge component to the final intro screen to motivate onboarding completion.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 79.4% with mean time over 5800s, needing an immediate completion incentive.

components.label: Includes starter treats and desktop toys.
